Name: Stardew Valley Sebastian
Author: leaningKnife
Description:
I decided to test out creating my own portraits for Stardew Valley characters for my game playthroughs and then decided I'd post them here too if anyone wants to try them out.  
So far I just finished Sebastian. Will continue with rest of characters.
Hopefully I'll eventually get to SVE and Ridgeside characters too!


* NOTE: I have some portraits of Sebastian smoking since he smokes in game. If that bothers you, probably don't use this mod. 


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
You'll need SMAPI, Content Patcher (I think), and Portraiture mods first to use this mod.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
After downloading those 3 mods, here's general steps: 

1. Down this portrait mod 

2. Unzip folder "leaningKnife" and drop folder into the "Portraits" folder in your "Portraiture" mod 
(example:  C:\Program Files (x86) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods > Portraiture > Portraits >leaningKnife)

3. Afterwards, just launch SMAPI stardew valley and find Sebastian

4. Talk to him. Then click "P" button to toggle through different portraits. You'll see the different names on lower left side of your screen above the talk box. "Vanilla" is the original portrait, "leaningKnife" is mine!
